item.title: Perimenopause Misinformation and Supplements
item.description:
• Summary: A growing wave of misinformation surrounding perimenopause is being amplified by social media influencers, often promoting unregulated supplements and hormone therapies without scientific backing. This trend exploits gaps in medical education and patient awareness, leading many women to seek unproven treatments for symptoms like hot flashes, mood changes, and sleep disturbances. Experts call for better evidence-based communication and regulatory oversight.
